headline: In short: Bet 33% was the top play, and you found it.

paragraphs: You held T♦ K♠ in the big blind, against Villain, a LAG player, on the button. Pre-flop, Villain opened to 2.5 bb and you called. The flop came 3♥ 2♠ 6♠. It was your turn to act with 5 bb in the pot.
sections.title: The hand

paragraphs: You chose Bet 33% (EV 2.57 bb), the top play against Villain's range. Verdict: Best. Your equity against Villain's whole range is 46.4%.

Bet 33%: Villain folds 34% of the time, more than the 23.1% a bet this size needs to profit on folds alone (1.5 bb / (5 bb + 1.5 bb)), so the folds alone pay for it, even when every hand that continues beats you. On top of that, you have 37.1% equity against the hands that continue.
Right now you are ahead of 47.0% of Villain's range. The largest parts of the range are Weak draw (20.6% of it; your equity 61%) and Air (20.6% of it; your equity 80%).
sections.title: The verdict

paragraphs: Villain is a LAG player. Loose-aggressive: wide ranges, frequent pressure, more bluffs.
Villain's range narrowed with each action: Pre-flop: opens to 2.5 bb.
The range in the Range tab is the range this puzzle was graded on.
